name: Crazy Eights
description: Crazy Eights is a popular shedding card game, especially beloved by children. The objective is simple: be the first player to discard all your cards. Players take turns playing cards to a central discard pile, matching either the rank or suit of the top card. The eponymous "crazy" 8s are wild cards that can be played on anything and allow the player to change the suit.

Country/Region of Origin: United States
Time Period: 1930s
Creator(s): Unknown (folk game)
Etymology: Named after the wild 8 cards that can "go crazy" and change suits

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 7
Optimal Players: 3-5
Partnerships: No (individual play)

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included (optional in some variations)

Standard deck of playing cards
Flat surface for discard pile

Players  Cards per Player 
---------------------------
 2 players  7 cards each 
 3-4 players  5 cards each 
 5-7 players  5 cards each 
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise, one card at a time
If the turned-up card is an 8, it is buried in the middle of the pack and the next card is turned up
